name: vtgrab
description: VTGrab - series/episode analyzer and download job orchestrator running on Cloudflare Workers (D1 + R2 + Queues).

scripts.predev: npm run build:client && wrangler d1 migrations apply vtgrab-db --local
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.frontend-test.json --noEmit
scripts.db:list: wrangler d1 execute vtgrab-db --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
